expectations.text: Explains the ISA2027 PTS structure: Prototype Protection Basic (assessed at AL2) vs Prototype Protection Facilities (AL3), with Facilities including Basic's scope
expectations.evidence: "The label structure becomes PTS: Prototype Protection Basic (AL2) and Prototype Protection Facilities (AL3), where Facilities encompasses Basic."

expectations.text: Maps the need: physical test facilities/vehicles imply the Facilities label at AL3 (on-site assessment)
expectations.evidence: "Because your work involves vehicle testing and on-site prototypes, you will almost certainly need the AL3 route... Under ISA2027 that means Prototype Protection Facilities"; AL3 = "comprehensive on-site assessment".

expectations.text: Describes the restructured prototype module content: two domains (organizational; physical & environmental) incl. new traceability/lifecycle and disposal/return-of-vehicle controls
expectations.evidence: "restructured into 20 controls in two domains (Organizational Requirements; Physical & Environmental Security), with new traceability/lifecycle and disposal/return controls."

expectations.text: Handles the transition: ISA-6-era prototype labels remain valid; new orders from 2027 use the PTS structure
expectations.evidence: "Order by December 31, 2026: ISA 6... Order from January 1, 2027: ISA2027 [PTS]... Existing labels keep their full validity."

expectations.text: Covers practical preparation: facility security evidence, camera/visitor regimes, lifecycle tracking of parts, disposal procedures
expectations.evidence: "Expect physical inspection: perimeter and zone security, access control, camouflage and transport rules, test-drive protections, photo and film controls"; plus traceability/lifecycle and disposal/return controls.
